d: Netflix's first Pakistani original series, Jo Bachay Hain Sang Samait Lo, starring Fawad Khan, Mahira Khan and Hania Aamir, has sparked a fresh controversy in India even before its release. The All Indian Cine Workers Association has urged Prime Minister Narendra Modi to stop the series from streaming in India, citing national security concerns. The debate comes amid the government's May 2025 advisory asking OTT platforms to discontinue Pakistani-origin content. With Indian audiences continuing to watch Pakistani dramas, the controversy raises important questions about streaming platforms,…
